title: Exported PDU dissector improvements
description:
Fully dissect the "dissector data" tag's contained values, rather than
just showing it as hex bytes.

Use an expert info item when the dissector data version isn't 1, instead
of just asserting out of the dissection.

Add an expert info for unrecognized tags, where a comment suggested it
could be added.

notes.body: As all those fields are specific to the TCP dissector data tag, it should be reflected in the filter name (disector_data only is confusing IMHO).
I don't disagree. I was sticking to the existing convention in the file, but with your blessing I'll rename the fields (existing and new).

unassigned @pquantin
The format description describes is as "Non-zero if this is reassembled data". So it would probably be better using FT_BOOLEAN instead so that we do not rely on a 0/1 value.

I tried making it a `FT_BOOLEAN`, but regardless of which TFS I gave it, the dissection only showed it as "(Unknown)". Maybe I wasn't using it correctly, or maybe `FT_BOOLEAN` only works for single-bit fields. I'll keep poking at it.

I could make it a `range_string` instead of a `value_string` perhaps?
Why not simply use FT_BOOLEAN without a TFS? It should automatically display true / false as far as I can remember (I do not have access to the code right now)

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9597/diffs?diff_id=587364548&start_sha=4f939229d6b4a02c444942a58cb6938353e04885#fe0745d9267eccca86da402267e33be54ac0e652_492_486)
maybe we should use the temporary u32 variable to fetch the is_reassembled as a I'm not sure gint is always 4 bytes for all platforms / compilers we support.
Moreover it would allow to properly transform the "Non-zero" value to TRUE

`hf_exported_pdu_ddata_is_reassembled` is declared as a `FT_UINT8`. Wouldn't that mean `proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint()` would only fetch eight bits of data, and pad it out to the size needed for `tcpdata->is_reassembled`?

the `proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint` function signature takes a guint32 not a guint8. Depending on the machine endianess, I'm not sure whether this will always work or not. Moreover as the value can be different from 0/1 according to the coments in the header (non zero value) I guess it would also be cleaner to assign a non zero value to TRUE explicitly
Ah, sorry, I misunderstood.

commits_data.title: Exported PDU dissector improvements
commits_data.message:
Exported PDU dissector improvements

Fully dissect the "dissector data" tag's contained values, rather than
just showing it as hex bytes. Rename it to "TCP dissector data" to
reflect its purpose.

Use an expert info item when the dissector data version isn't 1, instead
of just asserting out of the dissection.

Add an expert info for unrecognized tags, where a comment suggested it
could be added.
